description: This file defines the Utils class within the JmesPath namespace. It provides utility functions for type checking, value comparison, sorting, slicing, and other operations used internally by a JMESPath implementation in PHP.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A collection of static utility methods for type determination, comparison, sorting, and slicing, used in the context of JMESPath expressions in PHP.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Determines if a value is considered truthy within JMESPath logic.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the JMESPath data type equivalent of a PHP variable.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a JMESPath-compatible object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is a JMESPath-compatible array.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Performs a JSON-aware comparison between two values.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two values with type safety, handling numeric and non-numeric cases.

methods.name: stableSort
methods.description: Sorts an array stably according to a provided comparison function.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Creates a slice of an array or string similar to Python slices.

methods.name: adjustEndpoint
methods.description: Adjusts a slice endpoint based on array/string length and step.

methods.name: adjustSlice
methods.description: Calculates start, stop, and step indices for slicing.

methods.name: sliceIndices
methods.description: Generates a sliced subset of an array or string based on indices.
